title: Conjugated transition restriction to an iterated overlap
statement:
Let $X,Y,Z$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $U$ an open cover of $X$, and $q:Y	o X$, $p:Z	o Y$, $t:Z	o X$ with $p\mathbin{\gg}q=t$ [def-pc-base-change]. Write $V=U	imes_XY$, $W=V	imes_YZ$, $U^t=U	imes_XZ$, with chart projections $v_d:V_d	o U_d$, $w_d:W_d	o V_d$, $u_d:U^t_d	o U_d$. Let $d_d:W_d	o U^t_d$ be the universal lift with projections $W_d	o Z$ and $w_d\mathbin{\gg}v_d$, as in [def-pc-overlap-pair-canonical-comparisons]. Fix $a,b\in U.I_0$ and module sheaves $N_d$ on $U_d$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. Put $K= W_a	imes_ZW_b$ with projections $r_a,r_b$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. All products and comparisons are the canonical chosen pullbacks. Write $P_f$ for tensor pullback and $f^*$ for abstract module pullback. Let $C_d:w_d^*v_d^*N_d\simeq d_d^*u_d^*N_d$ be pullback composition along $w_d,v_d$, followed by congruence along $d_d\mathbin{\gg}u_d=w_d\mathbin{\gg}v_d$, followed by inverse composition along $d_d,u_d$. Given a scheme $H$, maps $h_d:H	o U^t_d$ for $d=a,b$, $z:K	o H$ with $z\mathbin{\gg}h_d=r_d\mathbin{\gg}d_d$, module sheaves $S_d$ on $H$, and isomorphisms $	au_d:S_d\simeq h_d^*u_d^*N_d$, define $\xi_d:z^*S_d\simeq r_d^*w_d^*v_d^*N_d$ by pullback of $	au_d$, composition and congruence along $z\mathbin{\gg}h_d=r_d\mathbin{\gg}d_d$, inverse composition along $r_d,d_d$, and pullback of $C_d^{-1}$. Composition in all displayed formulas is Lean order, written $\mathbin{\gg}$ [def-pc-local-overlap-transitions]. Take a module sheaf $M$ on $Z$ and isomorphisms $e_d:u_d^*N_d\simeq (U^t_d	o Z)^*M$. Assume a map $
u:H	o Z$ with $h_a\mathbin{\gg}(U^t_a	o Z)=
u=h_b\mathbin{\gg}(U^t_b	o Z)$. Let $D^t$ and $D^W$ be the canonical descent data of $M$ on $U^t$ and $W$, and $\epsilon_d:w_d^*v_d^*N_d\simeq(W_d	o Z)^*M$ the iterated component comparisons [def-pc-overlap-pair-canonical-comparisons]. For $	heta=	au_a.\mathrm{hom}\mathbin{\gg}h_a^*(e_a.\mathrm{hom})\mathbin{\gg}D^t.\mathrm{hom}(
u,h_a,h_b)\mathbin{\gg}h_b^*(e_b.\mathrm{inv})\mathbin{\gg}	au_b.\mathrm{inv}$, take the chart modules A_d = v_d^*N_d and any pair morphism phi:s_a^*A_a -> s_b^*A_b on L = V_a times_Y V_b, where s_a,s_b are its projections. Suppose its canonical base change BC(phi) to K [def-pc-overlap-pair-canonical-comparisons] equals xi_a.inv followed by z^*theta followed by xi_b.hom. Then r_a^*(epsilon_a.hom) followed by D^W.hom(r_a followed by W.f a,r_a,r_b) equals BC(phi) followed by r_b^*(epsilon_b.hom). That is exactly the canonical overlapPairSquare with A, p, D^W and epsilon. This statement contains no tensor stage morphism, model recovery equation or existence assertion. All morphisms and comparisons above are in Lean composition order.

lean.statement:
theorem overlap_conjugate_restriction {X Y Z H : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.OpenCover.{u})
    (q : Y ⟶ X) (p : Z ⟶ Y) (t : Z ⟶ X) (h : p ≫ q = t)
    (N : (d : U.I₀) → (U.X d).Modules) (M : Z.Modules)
    (e : ∀ d, (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom t d)).obj (N d) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((U.pullback₁ t).f d)).obj M)
    (a b : U.I₀) (ν : H ⟶ Z)
    (ha : H ⟶ (U.pullback₁ t).X a) (hb : H ⟶ (U.pullback₁ t).X b)
    (hνa : ha ≫ (U.pullback₁ t).f a = ν) (hνb : hb ≫ (U.pullback₁ t).f b = ν)
    (z : pullback (((U.pullback₁ q).pullback₁ p).f a)
      (((U.pullback₁ q).pullback₁ p).f b) ⟶ H)
    (hza : z ≫ ha = pullback.fst _ _ ≫ overlapIteratedChartHom U q p t h a)
    (hzb : z ≫ hb = pullback.snd _ _ ≫ overlapIteratedChartHom U q p t h b)
    (S T : H.Modules)
    (τa : S ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback ha).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom t a)).obj (N a)))
    (τb : T ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback hb).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom t b)).obj (N b))) :
    ∀ (θ : S ⟶ T),
      θ = overlapConjugatedTransition U t N M e a b ν ha hb hνa hνb S T τa τb →
    let ξa := overlapDirectRestrictionIso U q p t h N a b a ha z
      (pullback.fst _ _) hza S τa
    let ξb := overlapDirectRestrictionIso U q p t h N a b b hb z
      (pullback.snd _ _) hzb T τb
    let W := (U.pullback₁ q).pullback₁ p
    let D := (modulesPseudofunctor.toDescentData W.f).obj M
    let ε := overlapIteratedComparison U q p t h N M e
    let V : Y.OpenCover.{u} := U.pullback₁ q
    let A := fun d ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q d)).obj (N d)
    ∀ (φ : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst (V.f a) (V.f b))).obj (A a) ⟶
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.snd (V.f a) (V.f b))).obj (A b)),
      modulesPseudofunctor.overlapPairBaseChangeHom (V.f a) (V.f b) p
        (V.pullbackHom p a) (V.pullbackHom p b) (W.f a) (W.f b)
        (V.pullbackHom_map p a) (V.pullbackHom_map p b) (A a) (A b) φ =
        ξa.inv ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback z).map θ ≫ ξb.hom →
      overlapPairSquare V A p D ε a b φ
